biggest_catch: No limit on referrals at $100 each — but your friend must fund qualifying direct deposits totaling $1,000 and keep the account in good standing for 60 days before either of you is paid.
catches: Friend must open a new NESC Credit Union checking account with qualifying direct deposits totaling at least $1,000
New members must not have been NESC members or had direct deposits in the past 3 years
Both accounts must be in good standing for 60 days; rewards processed by the 10th of the following month
No limit on the number of referrals — $100 per successful referral, unlimited
NESC serves the Merrimack Valley and Southern New Hampshire (Methuen, Lawrence, Andover, North Andover, Haverhill, Salem NH and nearby communities)
NESC cannot tell you whether your referral opened an account — your friend must tell you themselves

steps: Be a current NESC Credit Union member
Click 'Start Referring Today' on the official refer-a-friend page and register to get your referral link
Friend opens a new NESC checking account and funds it with qualifying direct deposits totaling at least $1,000
After the new account is open and in good standing for 60 days, both you and the friend receive $100 (processed by the 10th of the following month)
timing: Registering + sharing the link takes ~10-15 minutes active; the $100 pays after the friend's account is open and in good standing for 60 days (processed by the 10th of the following month).
